desc: The Labtron High Speed Centrifuge LHS-A20 is a high-speed centrifuge with temperature control for fast, stable, and repeatable sample separation—ideal for research and biotech laboratories, as well as sample-prep workflows that demand high performance. title: Labtron Handheld Airborne Particle Counter LHPC-A11
desc: The Labtron LHPC-A11 is a handheld airborne particle counter for practical air quality monitoring and workplace cleanliness validation—ideal for cleanrooms, laboratories, healthcare facilities, pharmaceutical and electronics sites, and production areas requiring particulate control. title: Labtron Gel Documentation System LBGD-A12
desc: The Labtron Gel Documentation System LBGD-A12 is a gel documentation system for sharp, stable, and measurable imaging and analysis of electrophoresis results—ideal for life science and biotech laboratories, molecular research, and educational and diagnostic facilities. title: Labtron Disintegration Tester LDIT-A12
desc: The Labtron Disintegration Tester LDIT-A12 is designed for accurate, repeatable tablet and capsule disintegration time testing, supporting QC/QA needs in the pharmaceutical and nutraceutical industries and testing laboratories. With an operating noise level of <60 dB and total power of 600 W, the LDIT-A12 helps ensure batch consistency and compliance with disintegration test procedures in the laboratory.

title: Labtron Biochemical Incubator LBCI-A10
desc: The Labtron Biochemical Incubator LBCI-A10 is a 100-liter incubator with stable temperature control for sample incubation needs in microbiology, biochemistry, research, and QC laboratories. The stainless steel chamber supports cleanliness and durability, and comes with 2 shelves, an LCD display, and a test hole for monitoring or fitting an external sensor. Using CFC-free refrigerant and a timer of up to 9,999 minutes, this unit suits daily incubation workflows that require precise, reliable temperature control.

title: Labtron Benchtop Ball Mill LBBM-A20
desc: The Labtron Benchtop Ball Mill LBBM-A20 is a benchtop ball mill for efficient material grinding and milling, suited to sample preparation, particle size reduction, and material homogenization for R&D and quality control laboratory needs. Its compact benchtop design makes it easy to place on a workbench, making it a practical solution for particle size reduction ahead of further analysis or material formulation.

title: Labtron Automatic Polarimeter LPMR-A31
desc: The Labtron Automatic Polarimeter LPMR-A31 is an automatic polarimeter for fast, precise measurement of optical rotation, specific rotation, sugar degree (°Z), and custom concentration—ideal for the sugar, food & beverage, pharmaceutical, and chemical industries, and QC/QA laboratories.
